name: MeisterTask
description:
MeisterTask is the work management platform transforming how teams get work done. Hosted in Germany and built on simplicity, it brings together all your projects, tasks, and documentation in one place.

The MeisterTask MCP server connects your MeisterTask workspace to your AI assistant. Once authorized, your assistant can:

• Plan and structure projects from a brief or goal, creating sections and tasks in seconds
• Search across your work — tasks, projects, and notes — and pull the right context into any conversation
• Capture meeting notes as MeisterTask Notes, automatically turning action items into assigned tasks
• Run daily standups and weekly reviews by summarizing overdue, due, and recently completed work across your projects
• Read and edit Notes to keep your team's documentation up to date as work progresses

Get started fast with our template skills — pre-built workflows for the most common MeisterTask use cases, from project kickoff to task breakdown.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MeisterTask to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MeisterTask to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.meistertask.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MeisterTask MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MeisterTask lists 64 MCP tools, including mt_batch_execute, mt_checklist_items_create, mt_checklist_items_delete, mt_checklist_items_update, mt_checklists_create, mt_checklists_list, mt_comments_create, mt_comments_delete, mt_comments_update, mt_discussions_create, mt_discussions_list, and mt_discussions_resolve.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MeisterTask?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MeisterTask in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
MeisterTask requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MeisterTask is developed by MeisterLabs. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
